title.en: An Act to Provide Additional Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Bulacan, Amending for the Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended

text.en:
The provision of Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Bulacan, is further amended to read as follows:
"Bulacan, eight assistant provincial fiscals;"

The five incumbent special counsels in the Province of Bulacan shall automatically fill the positions of the five additional assistant fiscals provided for in this Act in accordance with their seniority, without need of any new appointments.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
